title: It works! Peel garlic with ease
text:
It works! Peel garlic with ease. You have to apply a bit of pressure when rolling the garlic, but the ease of peeling several cloves in less than a minute makes this my go to.
Simple to clean.

product_metadata.title: Fante's Garlic Press, Includes Cleaning Tool, 6.25 x 1-Inches, Aluminum
features: Fantes Cousin Umberto's Garlic Press for crushing garlic easily, with or without peeling garlic skins, and adding depths of flavor to favorite dishes
Made from heavyweight aluminum for strength and durability; cleaning tool included
Easily crush garlic without transferring strong odors to hands; tackles garlic quickly, with or without the skin removed
Simply place garlic clove inside and squeeze handle together; cleaning tool dislodges stubborn food bits for easier cleanup
Sturdy, durable, easy to use; cleaning tool included; hand wash in warm, soapy water
description: Fantes Cousin Umberto's Garlic Press crushes garlic easily in just seconds, with or without removing the skin. A helpful addition to food preparation and cooking tools, it’s easy to add depths of flavor to favorite dishes. Simply place a clove of garlic inside, close the handle and squeeze with both hands. With or without peeling garlic skins, Cousin Umberto's Garlic Press tackles garlic effortlessly. Cleaning tool included to quickly dislodge stubborn food bits for easier cleanup. Made from heavyweight aluminum for strength and durability. Hand wash in warm, soapy water. Fante’s, The Italian Market Original since 1906. Brought to you by HIC Harold Import Co.
